title: NOTE COMPLETION PRACTICE & TIPS
description: Develop skills for completing notes while listening to lectures or talks.
transcript: Today's lecture focuses on renewable energy sources. Solar power is becoming increasingly cost-effective, with prices dropping by 40% over the past decade. Wind energy now accounts for approximately 15% of global electricity generation. Hydroelectric power remains the most reliable renewable source, providing consistent energy output. The main challenge facing renewable energy is storage technology, which needs significant improvement to handle intermittent power generation.

title: Lecture on Climate Change: Note Completion
description: Practice note completion with academic lecture content.
transcript: Climate change represents one of the most pressing challenges of our time. The average global temperature has increased by 1.1 degrees Celsius since the late 19th century. This warming is primarily attributed to greenhouse gas emissions from human activities. The consequences include rising sea levels, more frequent extreme weather events, and ecosystem disruption. Mitigation strategies include transitioning to renewable energy, improving energy efficiency, and implementing carbon pricing mechanisms.
